callerPins.contract: Static schema metadata and chain provider.
Source version validated before migrate_value; migrated Value deserializes to T; current reads validate the full chain.
Held cases cover duplicate/out-of-order/missing/extra and current-version validation; no direct from_version > target test.

callGraphAndContract.registration: VersionedSchema::migrations returns &'static MigrationChain<T>; steps are callback function pointers in a static slice. No runtime registry, dynamic discovery, trait-object callback dispatch, or FFI registration path was found.
callGraphAndContract.loader: Text/legacy/binary readers normalize to JSON Value; load_migrated_value validates source version, calls T::migrations().migrate_value(...), then deserializes migrated Value to T. Current reads also validate the full chain.
callGraphAndContract.directPublicCall: migrate_value is public through serialization reexports. It validates target chain and loops over from_version..target_version. If from_version > target_version the range is empty and original Value returns unchanged after validation. Loader avoids this by checking source first. Existing CR-SERIALIZATION-0001 tracks this direct-call boundary.
callGraphAndContract.testCoverage: migration_failure_contract covers Text schema-zero loading where version-0 callback rejects, preserving StepFailed schema id/source version/nested cause. Held migration_contract covers table shape errors and current-version validation. Neither tests direct from_version > target.
